summary:
I finished the client RED half of U8 in 32 minutes (20:23 to 20:55 AST, within the 90-minute budget). I wrote one new test file for T10 and made the two authorised amendments. No production file, legal markdown, landing page or script was touched: `git diff --quiet -- SmartCompareApp/src` is clean, so consent.ts and the other eleven anchors are unchanged. No snapshot file was added, `jest -u` was never run, and there is no `virtual:true` mock. The backend RED files are byte-identical to their report.

Base run at 1156f03c (jest 29.7.0, the three files): 36 nodes, 29 RED and 7 PIN. Every RED node fails on its own assertion, with no exception and no import error. The two Arabic brand-fence hits are exactly the word-regex lines the spec lists in 4.5.

I proved the RED nodes can be satisfied with a scratch prototype of LegalScreen, loaded through a scratch jest config that maps the screen module to it, so the worktree stayed untouched. All 31 behavioural nodes pass against it. The two source pins can only be checked by mirroring their logic over in-memory text: they pass on api.ts plus the new constant and on the prototype, and fail at base and on four source mutants.

I ran 13 behavioural mutants against the prototype and each one reddened at least one node. I also ran three alternative GREEN shapes (a `?lang=` query string, the i18next singleton, a lowercased hook) and none of them reddened anything.

One fix during the work: a crashed render left a queued once-value that leaked into later tests. I added `mockGet.mockReset()` in beforeEach, and after re-running the matrix the crash mutant reddens only its own 2 nodes.

Gates: tsc 5.9.3 `--noEmit` exits 0. eslint 9.39.4 exits 0 with 0 errors; the 2 warnings in LegalScreen.test.tsx were already there at base.

questions_for_orchestrator: Q-C1 (link label copy): the error-state link needs visible text. The eslint i18next/no-literal-string rule forbids a literal in src/screens, and __tests__/i18n/no-missing-referenced-keys requires every t() key in both catalogs. Spec 4.8 and UL18 do not list en.json/ar.json. Choose one: (a) authorise GREEN to add one key, e.g. legal.error.openWeb, in EN and AR (the copy-policy fence applies, and AR is marked for native review); or (b) reuse the existing profile.privacy / profile.terms titles as the link text, with no catalog edit. T10 does not pin the label, so either passes.

Q-C2 (scope of the LegalScreen.test.tsx amendment): beyond the endpoint asserts, I changed the two cache keys (:101 and :137 to *_en) and gave the local react-i18next mock a stable `i18n.language: 'en'`. Without these, GREEN's UL5 cache key and any `i18n.language` read redden 3 nodes in that file that pass today. Accept them as inside UL17's authorised file?

Q-C3 (constant contract): `export const LANDING_BASE_URL = 'https://qaren-landing-production.up.railway.app';` (no trailing slash) in src/services/api.ts, within 6 lines of API_BASE_URL. LegalScreen imports it from '../services/api' and has no URL string literal. The page paths are privacy.html, terms.html, ar/privacy.html and ar/terms.html (the ASC URLs). Rename or relocate at the gate if wanted. When qaren.app is attached, the value changes together with T10 on purpose.

Q-C4 (link mechanism): pinned as exactly one element with the accessibility role 'link' (accessibilityRole or role) in the error state, opening the page through react-native Linking.openURL. An expo-web-browser in-app browser would redden all 4 link nodes. Confirm Linking, which is the repo convention (ContactUsScreen, UpdateRequiredScreen, ResultsScreen).

Q-C5 (language rule): lang='ar' when the UI language starts with 'ar', else 'en'; undefined gives 'en'. The source may be useTranslation().i18n.language or i18next.language (both accepted); 'AR' upper-case is not asserted. Known asymmetry with the backend: T9 serves English for 'arabic', while a client startsWith rule would send lang=ar for it. This is unreachable because the client languages are only 'en' and 'ar'. Confirm no assertion is needed.

Q-C6 (strict cache write): after a successful fetch the AsyncStorage mock must hold ONLY legal_cache_{doc}_{lang}. No fetched-at stamp may be written, and the legacy key must not be written. GREEN may removeItem the pre-U8 legal_cache_{doc}. Confirm this strictness.

Q-C7 (brand fence at GREEN): the fence now scans the whole legal page, including <head>, comments and scripts. Every page except ar/index.html allows 0 standalone uses of the old Arabic word, and that word is also the verb 'compare!'. GREEN's Arabic legal text must therefore never use the bare imperative. UL11 lets GREEN update ADDRESS_COUNTS if the contact block changes, which is an edit to this test file by GREEN. Authorise that edit explicitly and name the counts GREEN may change.

Q-C8: LegalScreen.test.tsx still has two eslint warnings that were there at base (require in the markdown mock factory, late import), and its beforeEach uses clearAllMocks only, so a crashed render can leak a queued once-value into later nodes. I fixed both patterns in the new file only. Leave the old file as it is (minimal amendment)?

Q-C9 (cross-half consistency): the backend RED report's Q-R11 says T9 serves Arabic for 'ar', 'AR', ' ar ' and 'ar-BH'. The client only ever sends 'ar' or 'en', so no client node depends on how the server normalises. No ruling needed unless the orchestrator wants the client to send the raw language.
